title: rsonar en pratique
text:
rsonar, c’est quoi ?
rsonar mesure la qualite de code R, inspire de SonarQube :

Analyse statique (lintr)
Style de code (styler)
Couverture de tests (covr)
Bonnes pratiques package (goodpractice)
Dette technique + Quality Gate

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
Pourquoi c’est utile ?
Une seule commande, tout est centralise :

Resume console
Rapport HTML
Score qualite en %
Exports pour la CI (JUnit, SARIF, JSON)

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
Demo : depot rsonar-examples

Code propre : R/clean_code.R
Code volontairement sale : R/messy_code.R
Tests partiels
Workflows CI pre-configures

title: rsonar en pratique
rsonar en pratique
text:
1) Analyse complete
library(rsonar)
res <- sonar_analyse(".")
print(res)
Un seul objet contient : lint, style, couverture, bonnes pratiques, dette.

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
Sortie console
-- rsonar -- Quality Report --
  Fichiers : 12 R
  Lint     : 8 (0 err / 4 warn / 4 style)
  Style    : 1 non-conforme
  Coverage : 42.3%

-- Dette Technique --
  SQALE: E | Score: 37.8% | Duree: 3.1h

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
2) Score qualite rapide (IDE)
quality_score(".")
Avant un commit, pendant une revue, pour suivre l’amelioration.

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
3) Rapport HTML
sonar_report(res, output = "quality.html")
Affiche : score %, note SQALE, couverture, lint/style, dette detaillee.

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
4) Bloquer les regressions (Quality Gate)
quality_gate(res,
  coverage_min    = 80,
  lint_errors_max = 0,
  rating_min      = "C",
  fail_on_error   = TRUE)
Si le gate echoue, le pipeline CI bloque automatiquement.

5) Exports CI

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
6) Auto-fix avec sonar_fix()
16 familles de corrections — 12 appliquees, 4 en rapport :



Categorie
Exemple




styler / air
Formatage complet


spacing
x<-1 → x <- 1


true_false
if(T) → if(TRUE)


commas
c(1,2,3) → c(1, 2, 3)


simplify
if(x==TRUE) → if(x)


pipes
%>% → |>


assignment
= → <-


cleanup
Espaces fin de ligne

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
Utilisation
# Apercu (dry-run)
fix <- sonar_fix(".", dry_run = TRUE)

# Appliquer toutes les corrections
fix <- sonar_fix(".", dry_run = FALSE)

# Avec air (plus rapide)
install_air()
fix <- sonar_fix(".", formatter = "air")

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
7) Workflow complet : sonar_autofix()
Une fonction pour tout le processus :
sonar_autofix(provider = "gitlab")   # Analyse + commit + push + MR
sonar_autofix(provider = "github")   # Analyse + commit + push + PR
sonar_autofix()                      # Auto-detection de la plateforme

title: rsonar en pratique
text:
Pipeline CI
stages: [quality, autofix]

rsonar-check:
  stage: quality
  script: R -e "sonar_analyse('.'); export_junit()"

rsonar-autofix:
  stage: autofix
  when: manual
  script: R -e "sonar_autofix(provider='gitlab', verbose=TRUE)"

title: rsonar in practice
text:
What is rsonar?


rsonar measures R code quality, inspired by SonarQube:

Static analysis (lintr)
Code style (styler)
Test coverage (covr)
Package best practices (goodpractice)
Technical debt + Quality Gate

title: rsonar in practice
text:
Why is it useful?
Without rsonar, you run multiple tools separately and assemble results manually.
With rsonar: - One analysis command - Clear summary - HTML report - Quality percentage score - CI exports (JUnit, SARIF, JSON)

If the gate fails, the CI pipeline blocks automatically.

title: rsonar in practice
text:
Fix usage
# Dry-run: preview changes
fix <- sonar_fix(".", dry_run = TRUE)

# Apply all fixes
fix <- sonar_fix(".", dry_run = FALSE)

# Select categories
fix <- sonar_fix(".", fixes = c("spacing", "styler"))

# Use air formatter (fast)
install_air()
fix <- sonar_fix(".", formatter = "air")

title: rsonar in practice
text:
7) Full workflow: sonar_autofix()
One function for the entire fix workflow:
sonar_autofix(provider = "gitlab")   # Analyse + commit + push + MR
sonar_autofix(provider = "github")   # Analyse + commit + push + PR
sonar_autofix()                      # Auto-detect platform
What happens: 1. sonar_fix() corrects the code 2. Creates branch auto/rsonar-fix 3. Commits + pushes 4. Opens Merge/Pull Request automatically
